scope: A poem-first audio guide to all major movements of Edward FitzGerald’s 1859 first-edition 75-quatrain sequence, not a fabricated plot or an authenticated original Persian ordering.
editorial_boundary: Original English guided reading/criticism of FitzGerald 1859 FIRST edition of the Rubáiyát. Not a retelling of an invented original Persian narrative, nor attribution of all Persian quatrains to historical Khayyam; later English variants are not silently blended.
